text: Four courses, each building on the last, each teaching a real layer of the same job — Foundations, Databricks & Delta Lake, Fabric & Real-Time Analytics, and this course tying it together.

Foundations gave the vocabulary and first tools. Databricks & Delta Lake is where it runs at scale. Fabric & Real-Time Analytics added the real-time half. This course added the design thinking to plan any of it, and AI as a tool alongside the craft — not a replacement for the judgment behind a trade-off.

The retail platform, warehouse migration, and fraud detector weren't disconnected exercises — together they're proof the same toolkit builds batch, migration, and streaming systems alike. The portfolio and interview story built from them are yours now.

This track is a complete foundation, and not a ceiling. If you want to keep building: CI/CD for pipelines, infrastructure as code, orchestrating at scale with Airflow, event streaming with Kafka. None required — there for whenever the next system asks for it.
That's Data Engineering Career & Capstone — and the whole Data Engineering track. Four courses, three real capstone projects that are yours to show. Congratulations on finishing it.
